body.statement: For \(\Gamma_{k,m,0}\) with unit noncore weights, conditional on every \(f_i\in\mathcal K\) being selected and on \(0<x_1<\cdots<x_k<1\), one component contributes \(z(\prod_{i=1}^kx_i)T_k(x)\), where \(T_k(x)=\frac1{k+1}+\sum_{r=1}^k\frac{x_r^{r+1}\prod_{i>r}x_i}{r(r+1)}\). The ordinary monomial expansion of the \(m\)-component conditional message has exactly \(\binom{m+k}{k}\) nonzero coefficients.
body.justification: The family proves that relative core order and dense monomial expansion are both insufficient descriptions of the numerical cutoff dependence.
body.gap: Neither static independent-set counting nor scalar adsorption recursions exhibit this finite heterogeneous core-priority support obstruction.
body.consumer: The obstruction rejects any proposed FPT invariant that materializes all \(k\)-coordinate degree totals.
